head.title: Impromptu
head.subtitle: On seeing a flake of snow fall on a lady’s breast.
head.firstline: The envious flake came down in haste

notes.note: Anonymt epigram fra The Literary Cabinet, bind I, nr. 3, 1806, gengivet i en nyere videnskabelig kilde.

head.source: Uladzislau (Vladislav) Areshka: Emily Dickinson’s Original New England Pronunciation and Rhymes, ph.d.-afhandling, University of Portsmouth, 2025.

body.poetry: The envious flake came down in haste, To prove thy breast less fair; But griev’d to see itself surpassed, And melted to a tear.
